description.en: Remote workspace plugin: stores SSH hosts in a local encrypted vault (groups, jump hosts, SOCKS5/HTTP proxy), provides an interactive SSH terminal, browses and edits remote files over SFTP, shows remote Git changes and history, and binds a remote directory as a workspace so the agent's read/write/glob/grep/bash tools run on the remote host.
description.zh: 远程工作区插件：SSH 主机保存在本机加密保险箱（分组、跳板机、SOCKS5/HTTP 代理），提供交互式 SSH 终端、SFTP 远程文件浏览与编辑、远程 Git 改动与历史，并可将远程目录绑定为工作区，使 Agent 的 read/write/glob/grep/bash 都作用在远程主机上。
